jobs.title: Project Officer - Hazardous Materials
jobs.location: Harris Park, New South Wales, Australia
jobs.description:
Support the Project Managers in the delivery of asbestos and Hazardous Building Materials (HBM) programs across Sydney Water's property portfolio 

Permanent full-time role based in Parramatta with hybrid working arrangements 

EA11 - $124,955.37 + super and access to Sydney Water's extensive employee benefits 

About the role 

As a Project Officer - Hazardous Materials, you will support the Project Managers in the delivery of projects and programs relating to asbestos and other Hazardous Building Materials (HBMs) across Sydney Water's land and property portfolio. Working closely with Project Managers, you will help ensure legislative compliance, manage risk, and provide technical support across a diverse range of assets and projects. Additionally, you will provide technical subject matter expertise to the business under the supervision and guidance of the Project Managers. 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with asbestos and HBM experience who is looking to further develop their technical expertise while contributing to the safe management of critical infrastructure and property assets, ultimately creating a better life with world-class water services. 

What you will be doing 

Support the Project Managers in the delivery of Hazardous Building Materials (HBM) assessment, remediation and management projects across Sydney Water's property and building portfolio. 
Provide technical advice relating to asbestos and other HBMs in response to business and stakeholder requests across the asset lifecycle. 
Assist with the maintenance, data entry and ongoing management of HBM (Asbestos) Registers, associated databases and Sydney Water's HBM Management Plan. 
Support risk management activities by identifying, assessing and helping mitigate asbestos and HBM-related risks in accordance with legislative requirements. 
Review property and asset portfolios to identify requirements for new or updated HBM registers and assessments. 
Assist with the development of contractor project scope of services and procurement. 
Assist with the coordination and support of consultants and contractors undertaking asbestos and HBM investigations and remediation activities. 
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, business processes and Environmental Management System compliance. 
Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, land managers, regulators and contractors. 

About you 

You will bring technical knowledge of asbestos and hazardous building materials management, combined with strong organisational and stakeholder engagement skills. 

Ideally, you will have: 

Tertiary qualifications in Science, Safety, Occupational Hygiene or a related discipline. 
Three years or more experience in asbestos and/or HBM assessment, remediation and management. 
Experience conducting or supporting multi-site asbestos and HBM assessments and remediation programs. 
Experience in developing and implementing asbestos and other HBM management strategies, including corrective action and risk mitigations. 
Applied knowledge of relevant legislation, regulations, policies and industry standards relating to asbestos, lead and other hazardous building materials. 
Ability to identify and manage issues and constraints associated with the planning and delivery of HBM projects. 
Experience engaging and managing consultants and contractors undertaking field-based asbestos and other HBM works. 
Strong report-writing and technical review, skills. 
Effective oral communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills needed for managing stakeholders to achieve program/project outcomes. 
Well-developed organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities. 
Ability to foster teamwork as well as work independently. 
A current driver's licence and Construction Induction White Card. 
Licensed Asbestos Assessor certification will be highly regarded. 
Industry association membership with active participation, or willingness to become involved, will be highly regarded. 

Does this sound like you? Apply now! 

Closing date: 11.59 AEST on Sunday 23rd August

We support you through the application process and can modify as needed – let us know what you need. For more information, you can contact marc.evans2@sydneywater.com.au  

Please see the job profile for the role’s full accountabilities.   

Why join us  

At Sydney Water, your work will make a real difference in people’s lives—and your own. With diverse projects and roles, you'll find ample career growth opportunities. At Sydney Water, we actively seek and celebrate diversity, equity, inclusion, and individuality, fostering a safe environment where everyone can thrive and shape impactful community projects. We offer flexible working arrangements and opportunities for career progression among our many benefits.   

Dive into Our Great Benefits:  

Competitive Remuneration: We’ll ensure that your skills and contributions are valued and rewarded appropriately.  
Hybrid Work Environment: We offer a hybrid work model that balances remote work and office collaboration, supporting our team's productivity and well-being.  
Continuous Professional Growth: We will invest in your career with leadership and development programs to propel your success.  
24/7 Wellbeing Support: Access for you and your family to free and confidential mental health and general health support through our EAP portal.  
Discounted Private Health Insurance: Unlock affordable access to top-tier health coverage with our discounted insurance plans.  
Family First: Prioritise your family with up to 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave and a childcare allowance.  
Fitness Passport: Achieve your physical fitness goals using our Fitness Passport, granting you access to a multitude of gyms and pools across NSW.  
Novated Leasing: Get in the driver's seat of your financial future with our novated lease options.  

As part of the application process, Sydney Water will be collecting your personal information to assess your suitability for the role. Your personal information may also be used to establish a Dayforce talent profile. Your personal information will be collected in accordance with Dayforce’s Terms and Privacy Policy and Sydney Water’s Privacy Collection Statement – recruitment. Please note as part of the application process, you will be asked to undergo background checks which include a criminal history check.
